newsitem.title: FINLAND: RUOKATALO SAYS IS 2ND IN FRESH PIZZA MKT.
newsitem.headline: RUOKATALO SAYS IS 2ND IN FRESH PIZZA MKT.

text.p: Finnish food group HK Ruokatalo said in a statement on Wednesday it was the second biggest producer of fresh pizzas with a 41 percent market share in Finland, and the market leader in big fresh pizzas.
"HK Ruokatalo's market share in the fresh pizza market is 41 percent, so it is second in the market," it said. A spokeswoman said by telephone the market leader was Saarioinen.
In January-May 1997, Finnish fresh pizza sales grew 18 percent on the year ago period. Last year, Finns bought 35 million fresh pizzas, or seven pizzas each, it said.
